notes.title: 1.59 Small fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
Update 1.59 released

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a small bug that was preventing game server from being started
[*] Fixed physics related issue that was causing players to go through walls
[*] Hitbox made bigger to avoid flying in circles trying to hit enemy
[*] Blast from attack is made stronger to prevent very fast subsequent attacks
[*] Teleport range increased
[*] AI is now more human-like
[/list]

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Shields Update 1.21
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am happy to roll out update 1.21. In this update :

[list]
[*] New mechanic: Shields. When activated, the shield will block all damage as long as you have enough power ( power - damage ). When the attack is blocked, the attacker is bounced off of the victim, while both players get stunned
[*] Health regen. Until now there was no way to regenerate health. This is now solved by giving health after a successful attack. Upon attack the attacker is rewarded with health equal to half of the damage he/she inflicted. This will make fights more dynamic, longer and will even things out in the long run. Upon more testing it is possible that this will be adjusted and/or changed.
[*] Added visual flares on players to indicate if someone is moving or looking towards you
[*] Players can now change game language. Lithuanian, Russian, Polish, Romanian, 中国人, Espaniol, France etc. Currently languages are auto-translated (Googler Translater)
[*] Various game settings as well as input bindings are now saved to disk
[*] Some other fixes/adjustments
[/list]

I hope you like it and of course, as always and kind of feedback, thoughts, ideas and questions are welcome! Either here on Steam Community or in [url=https://discord.gg/JcvhM58xdW]Short Circuit Discord server.
[/url]
Any feature ideas, changes are welcome and will be considered as the game is in an early and evolving phase.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Short Circuit has received update 1.1 featuring:
[list]
[*] Reworked snapping to environemnt mechanics (now snapping works everywhere at any angle while holding Space and Ctrl)
[*] Settings for controls, FOV, mouse sensitivity and sound levels
[*] New map "Space Debris"
[*] New charge sound effect and visual identification when its active
[*] Fixed unresponsive movement bug when quickly changing directions
[/list]

notes.title: v1.01 Hotfix
notes.content: v1.01 Hotfix contains fixed CMS40 map boundaries error (player clip to the void of oblivion) as well as CMS40 CTF spawnpoints (spawn out of bounds)

notes.title: V1.0 Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41562148/02ff8f14b219db1c63c88312b5f96d30303537f2.png[/img]


Hello, 

Today Short Circuit is being released on Steam!

Game has seen various adjustments as follows:
[list]
[*] Movement mechanics were tuned and adjusted to meet requirements of pro players, now it is more aggressive, fast and more controllable
[*] Improved HUD for greater readability
[*] Current map has seen size adjustments considering feedback from early testers
[/list]

This is an Early Access release so the game will likely still has some bugs or errors. Anyone is welcome to help by sending a message on [url=https://discord.gg/JcvhM58xdW]Discord[/url]! 

Have a nice day!
